create_dataset_from_default_config: create a Dataset instance from the default JSON config for a given dataset name
create_dataset_from_config_file: create a Dataset instance by loading configuration from a JSON config file
create_dataset_from_config_string: create a Dataset instance by parsing a JSON config string
get_dataset_chunks: get a list of chunks from a Dataset for batch processing
review_dataset_process_chunk: review the Dataset abstract method process_chunk that maps data into KILT format
